cues: The one where the current flows in the same direction it would through the hot junction of a Seebeck circuit of the same metals: for copper and iron, from copper to iron.
That makes sense: a working thermocouple is a heat engine, taking in heat at its hot junction.
text: Which junction cools? The one where the current flows in the same direction it would through the hot junction of a Seebeck circuit of the same metals: for copper and iron, from copper to iron. That makes sense: a working thermocouple is a heat engine, taking in heat at its hot junction.
